verdict.rationale: Sentry documents a dedicated 'Billing Quota Management' page (sentry-docs-30) and tiered pricing plans (sentry-docs-10/11/32), implying quota/spend controls exist, but the evidence pack gives no detail on per-project caps, spend-limit alerts, or how error storms are throttled before hitting a bill. missing for 10: detailed docs on per-project quota configuration, spend-cap alerting/notification behavior, and independent confirmation that limits reliably prevent overage charges.
